rationale: Max scenario net load (load-renewable): t1=72, t2=77, t3=69. Required thermal = net load + reserve 8 => t1=80, t2=85, t3=77. Cheapest generator g1 (18/MWh) is dispatched at pmax=70 each period; g2 (36/MWh) covers the remainder within [5,45]. Worst-case margin equals reserve 8 in each period. Total cost = 210*18 + 32*36 = 4932.
